title: Statement of Work

sow.summary: Comprehensive design and full-stack web development services provided by Foobar Labs to Studio Den, covering basic web development, brand logo design, UI/UX web design, and full stack implementation.
out_of_scope: Third-party subscription or licensing fees not explicitly listed.
Ongoing post-launch maintenance beyond initial acceptance warranty.

All external dependencies or third-party API accounts are provided by Studio Den.
